truth_boundary: Production media and customer-facing presentation are outputs. They are not independent scientific verification.
continuity: Scheduled GitHub Actions continue without a new chat message, subject to Actions availability, permissions, quotas and workflow health.
demo_video_standard: Product-specific MP4/WebM demonstrating the actual usage flow; fallback browser walkthrough remains visible until a real video asset exists.
visual_standard: Product-specific 16:9 4K-ready visual with logo/identity, short description and QR route to long details.
